findings.expected: The linked-target protection test reaches BRAD logic on Windows.
findings.actual: Directory symlink creation fails with EPERM before BRAD is invoked.
findings.rootCause: The test requires Windows symlink privilege instead of a privilege-free junction.
findings.impact: Windows CI cannot run the safety regression in the current privilege environment.
findings.workaround: Use an allowed link type or run with explicitly provisioned symlink privileges.

findings.expected: The test parses supported npm pack JSON and asserts required package files.
findings.actual: The test indexes the result as an array; npm 12.0.2 returned an object keyed by package name.
findings.rootCause: Test harness assumes one npm output shape.
findings.impact: A valid package is reported as a failed test on the observed npm version.
findings.workaround: Run direct pack check; it succeeds and lists 33 entries.

findings.expected: An approved role/action matrix defines every forbidden role/action pair.
findings.actual: Selected role denials are implemented/tested but the approved matrix does not exist.
findings.rootCause: Missing product/QA acceptance decision; not evidence of an authorization implementation defect.
findings.impact: AC-02 and exhaustive A04 conformance cannot be judged.
findings.workaround: Retain selected tests and keep criteria BLOCKED until approval.

findings.expected: An owner-approved oracle defines omitted and empty acceptance criteria at create time.
findings.actual: Both forms returned 201 and persisted an empty list in Draft; API contract suggests the field is required, while AC-04 says required-vs-optional is unspecified.
findings.rootCause: Conflicting contract language; owner interpretation is absent.
findings.impact: AC-04 cannot be marked pass/fail; downstream requirement review is blocked.
findings.workaround: Observed Draft behavior and incomplete-requirement transition gate remain unchanged pending decision.

findings.expected: A host-discovered installed TEA skill is invoked and leaves verifiable evidence.
findings.actual: TEA instructions were only in an external cache; workspace `_bmad` and host skill registration were absent; the native loader reported not found.
findings.rootCause: Current workspace/host capability boundary; BRAD runtime defect is not established.
findings.impact: Native TEA execution and L4 routing evaluation remain unverified.
findings.workaround: Initialize a project with the installed native module and restart/use a host that registers the workflow; obtain consent before writing report artifacts.

findings.expected: Three independent developer worktrees and two independent QA stakeholder contexts collaborate through real handoffs.
findings.actual: No such stakeholder collaboration was executed; one separate read-only review context and one separate installer-candidate worktree were used.
findings.rootCause: Evaluation scope not completed; no defect attribution to BRAD.
findings.impact: Role usability, coordination, and three-developer dependency claims remain unmeasured.
findings.workaround: Run a dedicated multi-worktree experiment with independent host contexts.
